projectBriefConcise: Single Storey Flat Roof Rear Extension to the existing Bungalow, providing a new Living Room with Sliding Doors, a Bedroom and an En-Suite, replacing the existing Garden Room Conservatory, delivered under Permitted Development.
projectBriefFull:
## Project Overview And Goals

The aim of this project is to add a single storey extension to the rear of the existing bungalow, creating genuinely useful additional living and sleeping accommodation without disturbing the character of the rear of the property.

We spoke by telephone on Monday 7ᵗʰ September 2026 and confirmed the brief. The new extension will replace the existing garden room conservatory, which is a cheaply built structure that has reached the end of its useful life. Removing it releases the whole of the rear elevation and allows a properly built, properly insulated, year round extension to be put in its place.

The new accommodation will comprise a Living Room opening onto the garden through sliding doors, together with a Bedroom and an En-Suite running along the rear. You have already prepared a preliminary plan of these areas, and that plan forms the starting point for the design. Noble Architecture will develop it into a full three dimensional model and derive the formal drawings directly from that model.


## Proposed Rear Extension

The Living Room is the principal space, arranged to open directly onto the garden through a set of sliding doors so that the room reads as part of the outside space through the warmer months. Sliding doors suit this extension well. They are simpler than a folding system, they cost less, and across an opening of this width they give a cleaner and quieter action with far less ironmongery to go wrong.

A Bedroom and an En-Suite run along the back of the plan, giving the bungalow a self contained additional sleeping suite. On a single storey property this is a particularly valuable addition, because it adds a genuinely independent room without any of the cost, disruption or structural complexity of taking the building upwards.

The existing garden room conservatory will be demolished in its entirety before the new work begins.


## Roof And Construction

The extension will be built with a flat warm roof, insulated above the structural deck, and finished in EPDM single ply rubber membrane.

A warm roof build up places the insulation on the warm side of the structure, which keeps the deck above dew point and largely designs out the interstitial condensation problems that older cold roof constructions suffered from. EPDM is a single sheet membrane with very few joints, it is dimensionally stable, and it is about as close to maintenance free as a flat roof covering gets. For an extension of this size it is the sensible and economical specification.

Flat roof lights will be set into the roof to bring daylight deep into the plan. This matters a great deal on a single storey rear extension, because the only other source of natural light is the glazed rear wall, and without roof lights the part of the room nearest the existing house tends to sit in permanent gloom. The number and position of the roof lights will be resolved within the three dimensional model, where the effect can actually be seen rather than guessed at.


## Planning Route And Key Constraints

The Local Planning Authority is Rushcliffe Borough Council.

We agreed on the call that this project should be taken forward under **Permitted Development** rather than as a full Householder Planning Application, and that Noble Architecture will apply on your behalf for a **Certificate of Lawful Development for a Proposed Use or Operation**. That certificate is the council's formal written confirmation that the works are lawful and do not require planning permission.

During the call we ran initial checks on the property to make sure nothing already built would push the proposals outside the permitted development rules. The particular thing being tested for is the wrap around extension trap, where an addition to the side of a house, combined with a rear extension, takes the scheme outside what Class A allows. The property has not been extended to the side. The only previous addition is the existing garden room conservatory to the rear, which is being demolished in full, so the scheme is not caught by that rule.

We considered the full planning permission route and decided against it, for reasons worth setting down plainly:

1. A planning application is publicly advertised and invites neighbour objections. An application for a certificate of lawful development is not a matter of planning judgement at all. The council simply tests the proposal against the legislation, so there is nothing for a neighbour to object to.
2. A planning application takes longer to determine and costs considerably more, both in the council fee itself and in the far more extensive drawing and supporting documentation required to support it.
3. The permitted development route needs a much leaner document set, which keeps your professional fees down and gets the scheme into the council's system far sooner.

Noble Architecture will check the proposals against the permitted development criteria before anything is submitted, and will not knowingly submit a scheme carrying an obvious contravention. It must be understood, however, that the determination is the council's alone. Rushcliffe Borough Council reviews the submission and issues the certificate, and only that authority can do so.


## Submission And Handover

Noble Architecture is engaged on a submission only basis for this phase, which is what keeps the fee where it is.

Your own contact details will be given as those of the applicant. The certificate itself, and any query or request for further information the case officer raises, will therefore come directly to you rather than through Noble Architecture. If the council raises something that needs further drawing work, let Noble Architecture know and it will be quoted separately at that point.

Rushcliffe Borough Council accepts applications and supporting documents by email, so the submission will be made directly to the council. That avoids the national Planning Portal upload service charge of £85.00 entirely, which on a project of this size is a saving worth having.


## Survey And Measurement Information

You have confirmed that you will carry out your own survey of the property and provide the measurement information to Noble Architecture. This will take the form of photographs of the areas Noble Architecture identifies, with the dimensions marked over them.

This is the right call on a job of this size, and it is worth explaining why. A measured building survey, or a laser scan, adds a site visit, adds travel, and then adds a considerable amount of time registering and processing the survey data before any design work can begin at all. On a large planning application or a full building regulations package that investment repays itself several times over. On a straightforward single storey rear extension it would add cost and lead time out of all proportion to the benefit. You work within the construction industry and are entirely comfortable taking and recording dimensions, so it would be poor value to charge you for something you are well placed to do yourself.

The consequence, which is set out formally in the Building Surveying terms, is that the drawings will be prepared from the information you supply. Noble Architecture is not able to warrant dimensions it has not itself taken, and the accuracy of the drawings follows the accuracy of the information provided.


## Building Regulations

Building Regulations compliance for this project will be handled in full by **Sukhi Home Solutions**.

It is important to be clear that a Certificate of Lawful Development confirms only that the works do not require planning permission. It carries no Building Regulations approval whatsoever, and a separate Building Control application is required before any work starts on site.

Noble Architecture's appointment concludes at submission of the Permitted Development application. The drawings produced are concept and permitted development documents and are not construction information. All technical design, structural design, thermal performance, construction detailing, drainage and Building Control liaison sits with Sukhi Home Solutions. This is set out in detail in the Building Regulations terms.


## What You Will Receive

Because Noble Architecture works from a single intelligent three dimensional model, you get the benefit of the full 3D even on a project quoted at this level. The plans, elevations and site drawings are not drawn separately by hand; they are derived directly from the model. That is precisely what keeps the fee low and keeps every drawing consistent with every other one.

The model is a by-product of the process rather than an added extra, so it would be perverse not to put it in your hands. You will therefore have the **TrueVision** experience included at no charge, letting you walk through the proposals in three dimensions before anything is committed to, and **PlanVision**, where the full drawing set can be reviewed at your own pace.

The drawing set itself is deliberately lean. It is exactly what is required to obtain the certificate and nothing beyond it, which is the fastest and cheapest route to getting the scheme lodged with Rushcliffe Borough Council.
